name: Azure VNet / VPN / Gateway Deletion
description: Virtual networks, VPN gateways, and Application Gateway are how offices and apps talk to Azure. Deleting or rewriting them can cut the company off, or open a path the attacker prefers. Point-to-site VPN changes can also let their laptop into the network. This is impact and sometimes persistence, not a user-account trick. Gateway and VNet deletion should match a network change ticket.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
